title: Reward Model Interpretability via Optimal and Pessimal Tokens

bias_targets.methodology: Exhaustive single-token vocabulary scoring and multi-token optimization (using Greedy Coordinate Gradient) to identify systematically low reward scores assigned to marginalized identity terms (e.g., 'blacks', 'homosexuals', 'Jews').
Regression analysis comparing log-transformed word frequencies from English language corpora against reward model scores to detect the overvaluation of more common tokens (a 'mere-exposure' effect).
Correlating reward model scores with human-validated sentiment lexicons (AFINN-111, Bing) across positively and negatively framed prompts to measure asymmetric model sensitivity to token sentiment.
